svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of a multipart upload: Client, S3 front, Proxy, Cold tier. Create carries the attributes and the checksum algorithm and type; each part is hashed once and its md5, size and checksum are kept with the part; completion lists the stored parts, checks the client list against them, computes the composite md5 ETag with -N and the full-object or composite checksum, then completes create-only under the key entry.
svg.title: A multipart upload: part digests kept by the store, the ETag and checksum made at completion
svg.text: A multipart upload: part digests kept by the store, the ETag and checksum made at completion
Client
S3 front
Proxy
Cold tier
0 POST ?uploads: Content-Type, x-amz-meta-*, x-amz-checksum-algorithm, -type
1 create_upload(key, attrs): headers up front on S3, an attrs file on dir:
2 UploadId
Each part n, in any order, concurrently
3 PUT ?partNumber=n&uploadId: body, x-amz-checksum-crc64nvme of the part
4 One pass: md5 and the declared checksum of the part; a mismatch is 400 BadDigest
5 upload_part: stored with PartInfo { etag = md5, size, checksum }
6 200, ETag: "md5 of the part", x-amz-checksum-*
Completion
7 POST ?uploadId: parts (n, ETag, Checksum*), x-amz-mp-object-size
8 list_parts: stored etag, size, checksum of each part
9 Each listed part must equal what was stored, else 400 InvalidPart.
ETag = md5( md5 of part 1 || ... || md5 of part N ) with "-N".
FULL_OBJECT: crc combined from the part crcs and sizes. COMPOSITE: hash of the part checksums, "-N".
A full-object value in the request that differs: 400 BadDigest
10 complete(key, id, parts, record): takes the entry, HEADs both tiers (412 if present)
11 complete_upload create-only; the record is written with the object
12 200, ETag "...-N", ChecksumCRC64NVME, ChecksumType
No whole-object md5 exists for a multipart object, as in S3: the ETag is built from the part md5s, and the full-object crc from the part crcs
and sizes.
Nothing is re-read at completion. A store that cannot return per-part checksums cannot take a declared algorithm (section 9 of this document).
